fato_historico: 1997: Twenty-five people are killed in the second Souhane massacre in Algeria.
energia_do_dia: Today may invite a deep reflection on the sanctity of life and the strength found in community. As you navigate your feelings, consider the gentle power of empathy. Just as the world remembers the fragility of peace, you might focus on cultivating harmony within your own home. It is a good time to cherish those you hold dear.
frase_do_dia: Cherish the light within your heart and share it with the world today.
significado_numero: Represents the collective strength found through unity and deep emotional resonance.
conselho: Practice small acts of kindness to bring warmth to your emotional landscape.
